findings.highlight: each one was a great clash
findings.evidenceJa: 死闘が繰り広げられた
findings.governingReading: each time, a struggle to the death unfolded
findings.explanation: The lethal severity of each separate gate battle is reduced to size or spectacle.
The unusual written/read relation is reduced to its spoken generic category before the corpse is identified.

findings.governingReading: a stone bird made from mineral ore
findings.explanation: The familiar’s material is narrowed without support to crystal.

findings.evidenceJa: ここで消してしまうだけ
findings.governingReading: I will simply erase you here
findings.explanation: Caster’s threat and agency become apparent permission for Assassin to vanish.

findings.highlight: A low-class like you without a Noble Phantasm
findings.evidenceJa: 宝具も持たない下級の貴方
findings.governingReading: a low-ranking Servant such as you, without even a Noble Phantasm
findings.explanation: Omitting the ranked category leaves the insult grammatically incomplete and socially vague.

findings.highlight: I will act out my role
findings.evidenceJa: 与えられた役割は演じきってみせよう
findings.governingReading: I shall play my assigned role through to its end
findings.explanation: Assassin’s promise of complete performance and resolve disappears.
The planted bodily growth and its ruby reading collapse into abstract magic, weakening the mechanism of Caster’s control.
The violent internal explosion is accompanied by a boom, not a muted thump.
The rib-pierced body’s precise resemblance to opened petals becomes an awkward generic flower.

findings.highlight: You are getting worse every day
findings.evidenceJa: 日に日に度が過ぎていく
findings.governingReading: each day you carry your excesses further
findings.explanation: Assassin comments on the increasing degree of Caster’s conduct; the English turns it into a broad moral decline.
Assassin’s undiminished elegance is introduced with a word suggesting gaudy showiness.

findings.highlight: even if he shows his ribs
findings.evidenceJa: 胸から肋を見せようが
findings.governingReading: even with his ribs jutting through his chest
findings.explanation: The source’s bodily rupture is softened into voluntary display.
Assassin’s courtly sarcasm is presented as sincere emotional praise.

findings.highlight: allow me to joke around like that
findings.evidenceJa: この程度の戯言は許せよ
findings.explanation: Assassin admits verbal needling is his only available retaliation; the English makes it casual joking.

findings.evidenceJa: 艶やかな唇を歪ませた
findings.explanation: The bodily image and cultivated menace of her satisfaction disappear.
Caster’s triumphant vocal performance is reduced to unspecified expression.

findings.governingReading: the swordsman with the long blade
findings.explanation: mirror moon assigns Assassin the distinct social category of knight.

findings.evidenceJa: 許された時間は残り五日
findings.governingReading: five days remain of the time granted to him
findings.explanation: The remaining span belongs to Assassin’s continued existence; the English leaves it as an unrestricted deadline.

findings.highlight: the match will not be settled
findings.governingReading: the conflict will not be decided
findings.explanation: The lethal struggle ahead is trivialized into a sporting match.
